Overscaling Wbar toward the E_p=0 solution shrinks abar, which shrinks Vbar's drive, which shrinks abar further. Measured: |Vbar[0]| 10.475 -> 0.034 (ridge) and -> 0.250 (norm-preserving), with |abar^1| -> 0.0000 in both. Positive feedback to zero. No algebraic closure on Wbar can succeed while abar^l depends on Wbar^l multiplicatively.
